C1271.title: Fortinet FortiCloud SSO Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
C1271.summary: In January 2026, Fortinet disclosed CVE-2026-24858. When FortiCloud SSO is enabled, an attacker with a FortiCloud account and a registered device can bypass authentication and log into devices registered to other accounts. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.4, and Fortinet confirmed in-the-wild exploitation by two malicious FortiCloud accounts.
